dailyHeadline: CAAAAM'S UNDEFEATED 11-0 MARCH COLLIDES WITH WEEK 12 AS TRADE DEADLINE MADNESS ROCKS THE KINGSTON DESK
dailySubhead: With an 11-0 record and 1,655 points, Caaaam is laughing all the way to Keaney Blue, while ELord11 and Tylero0 trade tight ends like trading cards and Shipoopiehole snags Travis Kelce.
tickerTape: BREAKING: Caaaam sits pretty at a pristine 11-0 after a nail-biting 145.06 to 144.7 win over CarlaCote in Week 11!
TRADE WIRE: Shipoopiehole acquires Travis Kelce and Stefon Diggs from JewsInParis for Kincaid, McConkey, and Tyson!
TRADE WIRE: ELord11 and Tylero0 swap Trey McBride, Jameson Williams, and Tucker Kraft in a classic compulsive addiction move!
WAIVER WATCH: ELord11 splashes 1 FAAB on the Jacksonville Jaguars defense because why stop burning cash now?
STANDINGS ALERT: Owenriddell and CerealStroke anchor the basement at 2-9 while Caaaam cruises on an 11-game win streak!
WEEK 12 KICKOFF: Shipoopiehole faces owenriddell and PrayingGrantis takes on CarlaCote as playoff chaos ensues!

roasts.headline: Caaaam's 11-0 Empire Built on Pure Dominance and Week 1 Defense FAAB Blunders
roasts.body:
Let’s bow down to our overlord, Caaaam, who has officially dragged an 11-0 record, 1655.22 points for, and an 11-game win streak into Week 12. Fresh off a terrifyingly close 145.06 to 144.7 escape against CarlaCote, Caaaam continues to prove that blowing 50 FAAB on a defense in Week 1 was either 5D interdimensional chess or a psychotic break that somehow worked out. With 224.1 points left behind on the bench, even Caaaam's substitutes could probably start a franchise at URI and win the Atlantic 10.

Meanwhile, at the exact opposite end of the Kingston ecosystem, CerealStroke and owenriddell are marinating in a 2-9 purgatory. CerealStroke has wisely kept their wallet zipped with 0 FAAB spent all season, choosing instead to pick up Chimere Dike and the 49ers defense like a vagabond picking through the trash behind the Ryan Center. If Caaaam is the undisputed King of Kingston, the bottom two are currently trying to figure out how to pay tuition with discarded Subway coupons.

roasts.headline: Shipoopiehole Bulks Up with Kelce and Diggs While JewsInParis Recovers from Drake London PTSD
roasts.body:
The Rhody trade deadline room has officially caught fire. Shipoopiehole decided that sitting at 3-8 wasn't fun anymore and executed a blockbuster heist, acquiring Travis Kelce and Stefon Diggs from JewsInParis in exchange for Dalton Kincaid, Ladd McConkey, and Jordyn Tyson. JewsInParis, still trying to emotionally recover from famously trading away Drake London for Jordan Mason earlier this season, decided to keep the self-sabotage rolling by dropping Wan'Dale Robinson and Elic Ayomanor right into the waiver abyss.

Over in the ELord11 and Tylero0 therapy ward, the compulsive trade addicts couldn't go a single week without exchanging paper bags. ELord11 traded away Trey McBride to Tylero0 in exchange for Jameson Williams and Tucker Kraft. It’s like two kids trading holographic Pokémon cards behind the bleachers at Meade Stadium, except everyone in the league is watching and whispering about restraining orders.

roasts.headline: ELord11 Drops 1 FAAB on the Jaguars Defense While CerealStroke Refuses to Spend a Dime
roasts.body:
Waiver wire day in Rhody always reads like a true crime podcast, and Week 11 did not disappoint. ELord11, sitting comfortably at 3-8 with a 6-game losing streak and a bank account bleeding out after spending 90 FAAB, decided to invest 1 precious FAAB dollar to secure the Jacksonville Jaguars defense. They immediately celebrated this monumental acquisition by dumping the Kansas City Chiefs defense into the Kingston landfill. Classic ELord11 roster churn.

Down in the trenches, CerealStroke continues their legendary anti-spending campaign. Having spent exactly 0 FAAB all year, they casually scooped up Chimere Dike and dropped Corey Kiner, because why use the fake currency when you can just manifest waiver wire magic out of thin air? At 2-9, the strategy isn't exactly translating to wins, but hey—at least their FAAB savings account is fully intact for the apocalypse.

roasts.headline: Week 12 Slate Features Shipoopiehole vs. owenriddell in the Battle of Desperation
roasts.body:
As we stare down Week 12, the matchup board is an absolute minefield. We have Shipoopiehole squaring off against owenriddell in a glorious collision of 3-8 versus 2-9. Shipoopiehole just added Travis Kelce and Pat Bryant to an already chaotic roster, while owenriddell countered by desperately swapping out the Jaguars defense for the Detroit Lions. It's the fantasy football equivalent of two broken-down station wagons racing across the Kingston bridge with sparks flying everywhere.

Elsewhere, PrayingGrantis hosts CarlaCote in what can only be described as a clash of the titans—or at least a clash of someone building a stacked superteam against CarlaCote, who continues to mysteriously snipe wins out of witness protection. CarlaCote is sitting at 6-5 despite dropping Nico Collins and Blake Corum in past trades, proving she can win games while operating entirely off the grid. Grab your Del's Lemonade and settle in; Week 12 is going to get ugly.

powerRankings.blurb: An untouchable 11-0 record with 1655 points and an 11-game win streak. Even with 224 bench points left behind, nobody can touch the king.
Sitting comfortably at 8-3 with a loaded roster and 1,652 points. They just added Kirk Cousins because why not have extra artillery?
Also 8-3 and hauling in Trey McBride in yet another trade with ELord11. This superteam is dangerous if they stop sending fleece offers.
Sliding with a 3-game losing streak after shipping off Travis Kelce and Stefon Diggs. The Drake London ghost still haunts this franchise.
Operating out of witness protection at 6-5, nearly upsetting Caaaam last week by 0.36 points. Never count out the ghost.
Sitting at 5-6 on a two-game skid after draining all 100 FAAB dollars. The middle-pack blues have officially set in.
Stuck in a brutal 6-game losing streak at 3-8, trading tight ends hourly and spending 1 FAAB on the Jags D. Pure compulsive chaos.
At 3-8 but swinging for the fences by trading for Travis Kelce and Stefon Diggs. A glimmer of life in the Kingston underworld.
Riding an 8-game losing streak at 2-9. Swapping out defenses like a madman won't save this sinking ship.
Still holding 0 FAAB and 2-9 in the basement. They're collecting waiver wire backup wide receivers like baseball cards.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Jameson Williams & Tucker Kraft; Tylero0 received Trey McBride
tradeGrades.verdict: ELord11's trade addiction strikes again, handing over elite tight-end gold in McBride for a pair of rotational depth pieces.

tradeGrades.summary: Shipoopiehole received Travis Kelce & Stefon Diggs; JewsInParis received Dalton Kincaid, Ladd McConkey & Jordyn Tyson
tradeGrades.verdict: Shipoopiehole goes all-in for veteran firepower while JewsInParis continues collecting future mystery box assets.

tradeGrades.summary: CarlaCote received Nico Collins & Blake Corum; PrayingGrantis received Matthew Golden
tradeGrades.verdict: PrayingGrantis gifts a certified stud in Nico Collins to witness-protection legend CarlaCote for spare parts.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Drake London & Garrett Wilson; Tylero0 received Puka Nacua
tradeGrades.verdict: A classic trade-addict swap between ELord11 and Tylero0 where both players just wanted to look at new names in their lineup.
